basic_info.description: Single family home with elevated position on Rhode Island Street, with a large, fenced rear yard and lots of potential. Expansive views of the Western neighborhoods of San Francisco. Opportunity to improve the lower level unconditioned space to make this a truly special home in the coveted Potrero Hill District.  Concrete poured in place perimeter foundation. Large, fenced rear yard. Covered porch with concrete flooring for entertaining and relaxing at the rear of the home. Expansion potential!
